sentences.text: Doctor Zhivago -LRB- До́ктор Жива́го , Doktor Zhivago -LSB- ˈdoktər ʐɨˈvaɡə -RSB- -RRB- is a novel by Boris Pasternak , first published in 1957 in Italy .	Boris Pasternak	Boris Pasternak	Italy	Italy	novel	novel

The novel is named after its protagonist , Yuri Zhivago , a physician and poet , and takes place between the Russian Revolution of 1905 and the Civil War .	Russian	Russian language	novel	novel	protagonist	protagonist	Yuri Zhivago	Yuri Zhivago	Russian Revolution of 1905	Russian Revolution of 1905	Civil War	Russian Civil War
Due to its independent minded stance on the October Revolution , Doctor Zhivago was refused publication in the USSR .	October Revolution	October Revolution	USSR	Soviet Union

At the instigation of Giangiacomo Feltrinelli , the manuscript was smuggled to Milan and published in 1957 .	Feltrinelli	Giangiacomo Feltrinelli	Giangiacomo Feltrinelli	Giangiacomo Feltrinelli	Milan	Milan

Pasternak was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature the following year , an event which embarrassed and enraged the Communist Party of the Soviet Union .	Nobel Prize for Literature	Nobel Prize for Literature	Communist Party of the Soviet Union	Communist Party of the Soviet Union

The novel was made into a film by David Lean in 1965 , and since then has twice been adapted for television , most recently as a miniseries for Russian TV in 2006 .	Russian	Russian language	novel	novel	made into a film	Doctor Zhivago (film)	David Lean	David Lean
